headline: GIVE YOUR BODY CLOCK DAYLIGHT.
caption:
Sleep preparation is not only about bedtime.

Natural light in the morning or early afternoon helps support your sleep-wake cycle. Try using a daytime break to get outdoors in daylight. You can sit outside or enjoy a comfortable walk; this is about making room for daylight, rather than hitting an exercise target.

Choose a practical daylight opportunity that fits your day.

Save this for your next daytime break, and follow PSFR Health Systems for practical fitness, fuel and recovery ideas.
